name: SikaProof® Tape A+
tagline: Self-adhesive tape for internal jointing of SikaProof® A+ waterproofing system
summary: SikaProof® Tape A+ is a self-adhesive tape based on a polyacrylate adhesive with a carrier film and a release liner.
metaDescription: SikaProof® Tape A+ is a self-adhesive tape based on a polyacrylate adhesive with a carrier film and a release liner.
attributes: Fully bonded to the concrete structure (identical to SikaProof® A+)
No lateral water migration between the concrete structure and the membrane system
High adhesion and sealing capability, especially in cold and damp conditions
usage: Sealing and bonding overlap joints, connections and details within the SikaProof® A+ membrane system.
advantages: Fully bonded to the concrete structure (identical to SikaProof® A+)
No lateral water migration between the concrete structure and the membrane system
High adhesion and sealing capability, especially in cold and damp conditions
packaging: 2 rolls packed in one cardboard box Individual roll size | Length: 25 m Width: 150 (± 5) mm

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Watertightness of a Surface Sealing System SikaProof® A+ 12 / SikaProof® Tape A+, WISSBAU, Test report No. 2018-275

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Product must be stored in original unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions and temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: System structure
items.text: SikaProof® Tape A+ is a system component for internal jointing of the SikaProof® A+ membrane system. For more detailed information, refer to Sika® Method Statement: SikaProof® A+ system

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: The contact surface is the grey SikaProof® A+ hybrid bonding layer. It must be dry (or slightly damp), clean and free of any materials that could impair the adhesion. If the substrate requirements are not achieved, suitable measures must be taken. Contact Sika® Technical Services for more information.
